The discussion will look at how definitions of what we mean by “communities” influence the rights of the people affected and how context-specific definitions of “communities” are needed.
speakers: The event will feature civil society and community representatives from Africa,
Asia and South America and researchers who share insights on how the definition of “communities” affects how communities experience carbon market initiatives from a human rights
perspective. Followed by a discussion.

speakers: Speakers spanning disciplines and sectors, from EO and AI researchers to faculty, students, industry leaders, and community user/stakeholder voices,
including those without formal technical backgrounds, drawing on scholarship, practice, and lived experience worldwide.
